up: Return the first 1000 rows for IC50 activities against the target CHEMBL1974 (Receptor-type tyrosine-protein kinase FLT3). Include only activities with an exact standard relation ('=') and a non-null pChEMBL value. For each row, return the assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax_id, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value. Order the results by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID.
sql: WITH target AS (SELECT tid, target_type, tax_id FROM target_dictionary WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1974') SELECT assays.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, target.target_type, target.tax_id, cs.canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, activities.standard_type, activities.pchembl_value FROM target JOIN assays ON target.tid = assays.tid JOIN activities ON assays.assay_id = activities.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON activities.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE activities.standard_type = 'IC50' AND activities.standard_relation = '=' AND activities.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY md.chembl_id, assays.chembl_id LIMIT 1000
